title: Governance Ambiguity Risk Classification and Remediation Queue

PATCH_GOVERNANCE_GLOBAL_INVENTORY_002.reason: Patch 005 consumes the registered inventory outputs and additive registration evidence without requiring the global inventory completion gate to clear.

PATCH_GOVERNANCE_INVENTORY_PROVENANCE_AN.reason: Patch 005 depends on the registered provenance/core-rule bundle existing and being verifiable, not on it reaching a stronger terminal state.

objective.primary: Classify all 514 blocking governance ambiguities by deterministic authority risk and place them into a stable remediation queue.
objective.secondary: Identify the smallest high-risk ambiguity clusters that must be resolved before repository governance can be simplified or consolidated.
objective.tertiary: Separate authority risk, write-path risk, validation risk, provenance risk, and generated-view risk.
non_goals: Do not resolve any ambiguity in this patch.
Do not change the status of any inventoried surface.
Do not promote proposals, history, or generated views.
Do not delete duplicate or obsolete surfaces.
Do not select a canonical authority among competing candidates.
Do not repair missing Python dependencies.
Do not declare the full regression suite passing.

core_rule.scope: Governance ambiguity classification and remediation queue ordering only.
core_rule.effect: Determines the remediation order for ambiguous governance surfaces without resolving any ambiguity or conferring authority.

known_limitations: The inventory completion gate remains blocked by 514 unresolved ambiguities.
The default full-project global validator did not finish within the allotted validation window in this environment.
The full regression suite is blocked during collection by unrelated missing dependencies in this environment.
No inventoried surface gained authority from this patch.
rollback_procedure: Remove only newly added core-rule, provenance, evidence-set, test, and registry entries.
Leave the original inventory artifacts untouched.
Restore PATCH_GOVERNANCE_GLOBAL_INVENTORY_002 to its prior blocked state if the additive registration must be undone.
